Q: What is Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP)?
Option2: A protocol for monitoring and managing devices by reading and writing managed objects

Q: In SNMP, what is a trap?
Option2: An unsolicited alert from a device to the manager

Q: What is the Management Information Base (MIB) in SNMP?
Option2: A hierarchical database that defines managed objects and object identifiers for devices
Option3: A log file of Simple Mail Transfer Protocol
Option4: A list of Domain Name System records

Q: Which SNMP version adds authentication and optional encryption (privacy) with users?
Option2: Version 2c

Q: What are community strings used for in SNMP version 1 and version 2c?
Option2: Shared tokens that act like passwords for read-only or read-write access

Q: What is flow data in monitoring?
Option1: Full packet payloads for every frame
Option2: Summaries of conversations (such as five-tuple, bytes, and packets) used for traffic analysis and trend visibility

Q: What is packet capture used for?
Option2: Collecting and analyzing full frames/packets for deep troubleshooting

Q: What are baseline metrics used for?
Option2: Establishing normal performance to support capacity planning and anomaly detection

Q: What is log aggregation?
Option2: Centralizing logs from multiple systems for analysis and retention

Q: What is a Syslog collector?
Option2: A server that receives and stores system log messages from devices

Q: What is Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)?
Option2: A platform that ingests logs and events, correlates them, and produces alerts and dashboards
Option3: A replacement for Domain Name System

Q: What is application programming interface (API) integration in monitoring?
Option2: Programmatic retrieval or push of telemetry between tools and systems

Q: What is port mirroring on a switch?
Option2: Copying selected traffic to a designated monitor port for analysis

Q: What is ad hoc network discovery?
Option2: One-time or on-demand scanning to identify devices and topology

Q: What is scheduled network discovery used for?
Option2: Recurring scans to update inventory and topology over time
Option4: Resetting Simple Network Management Protocol users

Q: What is traffic analysis in this context?
Option2: Examining who talks to whom, volumes, and patterns to detect issues or capacity needs

Q: What is performance monitoring?
Option1: Only checking if a device is alive
Option2: Measuring key indicators such as latency, loss, throughput, and utilization over time

Q: What is availability monitoring?
Option2: Monitoring up/down status and reachability of devices and services

Q: What is configuration monitoring?
Option2: Detecting and recording device configuration changes (drift) against a baseline

Q: Which pairing is most secure for SNMP?
Option2: Version 3 with authentication and privacy enabled

Q: Which tool best helps confirm whether a spike in utilization is specific to one pair of endpoints without packet payloads?
Option2: Flow data analysis

Q: Which step helps reduce false positives in anomaly alerting?
Option2: Basing thresholds on observed baselines and seasonality
